portInfo.description: Ancona’s cruise programme is published by AdSP Mare Adriatico Centrale. For 2025 the authority announced 41 calls from April to late November, opening 13 April with Plantours’ Ms Hamburg, with MSC Crociere as protagonist on 28 dates; MSC Lirica (274.9 m, up to 2,679 passengers) was planned every Friday from 13:00 from Santorini at Banchina 15 facing the historic centre. For 2026 AdSP announced 45 calls, opening 19 February with Viking Star (07:00–17:00 from Venice) and closing 6 December, with MSC Lirica on 30 calls from 3 April. Those news pages are the primary schedule framing used here — individual sailing documents still govern your day.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm berth number on the gangway — Banchina 15 is named for MSC Lirica in AdSP copy, not guaranteed for every ship.
